name: Auto Design
description: Select your layout blocks in the editor, press the black AUTO box, and it auto-decorates them extreme-demon style.

outline.name: Outline
outline.description: Add thin outline bars along every exposed block edge.

corners.name: Corner Pieces
corners.description: Add small square pieces on exposed outer corners.

inner-detail.name: Inner Detail
inner-detail.description: Add a smaller inset square in the middle of every selected block.

thickness.name: Outline Thickness
thickness.description: Outline thickness in editor units (a block is 30 units).

color-channel.name: Deco Color Channel
color-channel.description: Color channel for generated deco. 0 = leave default. 1-999 are normal channels, 1005 = P1 color, 1006 = P2 color.

no-touch.name: Make Deco No Touch
no-touch.description: Generated deco will not collide with the player. Keep this on.

max-objects.name: Max Objects Per Press
max-objects.description: Safety cap so a huge selection can't freeze the editor.
